summary.text: Christopher Paul Buckles is the Republican candidate for Montana State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Tyson Running Wolf for a seat with no incumbent.
A healthcare administrator who has worked in Montana’s Medicaid waiver program for serious mental illness since 2015, Buckles lists Medicaid reform as his highest priority.

paragraphs.text: Christopher Paul Buckles served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1988 to 1994 and earned a bachelor’s degree from Ashford University in 2013, according to Ballotpedia.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Buckles said he was born in Exeter, California, lives in Saint Ignatius, Montana, and double-majored in sociology and healthcare administration.
He also said he completed more than 2,000 hours of mental-health training and has worked as a provider in the state’s Severely Debilitating Mental Illness Medicaid waiver program since 2015.
Buckles advanced from the Republican primary for Montana House of Representatives District 100 in 2024 and lost the general election to incumbent SJ Howell.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 8 on June 2, 2026.

In his 2026 survey responses, Buckles said he would prioritize protecting individual freedom, spending taxpayer money responsibly and providing practical solutions, including Medicaid reform, efforts against sex trafficking, and property-tax relief.
